import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a = sc.nextLong();
        long b = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long g = gcd(a, b);
        a /= g;
        b /= g;
        long bestNum = 1000000000L;
        long bestDen = 1L;
        if (b <= n) {
            System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
            return;
        }
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long current = (a * i) / b;
            if (bestDen * Math.abs(a * i - current * b) < i * Math.abs(a * bestDen - bestNum * b)) {
                bestNum = current;
                bestDen = i;
            }
            current++;
            if (bestDen * Math.abs(a * i - current * b) < i * Math.abs(a * bestDen - bestNum * b)) {
                bestNum = current;
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }

    private static long gcd(long x, long y) {
        while (y != 0) {
            long temp = y;
            y = x % y;
            x = temp;
        }
        return x;
    }
}
